visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins in a brightly lit exhibition hall at a booth labeled '魔術Channel-Davio'. A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a low-cut black top and a short striped skirt, stands behind the counter, waving enthusiastically at the camera while smiling. Behind her, a yellow neon sign reads 'Channel-Davio' and the background features several red and white lanterns hanging from the booth frame. (2) The camera cuts to a close-up of a white and silver gashapon machine filled with blue, purple, and silver capsules. Next to it is a yellow sign titled 'LUCKY DRAW' listing various prizes in Chinese characters. A small 'KISS' brand bell and a miniature 'BOOB-OFF' flag are visible on the table surface. (3) The scene shifts to a close-up of several printed portrait cards of various women in revealing clothing, arranged in a grid on the booth counter. A small red sticker on the top right of the display says '4th' in a stylized font. (4) The camera shows a close-up of two small table flags, one blue and one red, both featuring the 'BOOB-OFF' logo and Japanese text. The setting is indoors with high ceilings and industrial-style lighting typical of a convention center. (5) Two women stand in front of the booth; one is the woman from the first phase, and the other wears a green shirt and khaki pants. They are performing a magic trick where they hold white boards; the boards are moved rapidly, appearing to change state or reveal content through sleight of hand. (6) A young man wearing a black button-down shirt, a black baseball cap, and blue-tinted sunglasses walks confidently from the booth area toward the camera. He stops, poses with his hands on his hips, and tilts his head slightly as he looks into the lens.
